evidence.quote: Term sheet: class fund $50,000,000; attorneys' fees $12,000,000; clear sailing yes; unawarded fees revert to defendant no; distribution automatic
Term sheet: class fund $30,000,000; attorneys' fees $4,000,000; clear sailing no; unawarded fees revert to defendant no; distribution automatic
Ostrander Bell’s latest term sheet totals $34 million, within Brightline’s $40 million authorization and lower than the other current offers.
Accepting it secures automatic distribution and resolves the overlapping actions, so no further proposals are needed.

summary: Plaintiffs first raised fee terms in their opening term sheets, and fee amounts were negotiated alongside class relief before any final class fund was settled. The record does not show class counsel prioritizing firm economics, a fee-for-fund tradeoff, or defense leveraging fee interests. Defense did, however, select Ostrander Bell because its total proposal was lower than the competing class counsel offers and would resolve the overlapping actions, supporting a reverse-auction-tactics label.
